load_ply_verts_faces: load verts and faces tensors from a PLY file using load_ply
save_ply_mesh: save a mesh with verts and faces to a PLY file using save_ply
load_ply_raw_data: load raw PLY data including verts, faces, colors, and normals using _load_ply
mesh_ply_format_read: read a PLY file into a PyTorch3D Meshes object using MeshPlyFormat
pointcloud_ply_format_save: save a PyTorch3D Pointclouds object to a PLY file using PointcloudPlyFormat
